verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own REST API to read, create and manipulate space content. It uses Bearer tokens, a TypeScript SDK (npm install @capacities/api), an OpenAPI spec and header-exposed rate limits, so scripts and pipelines can automate the product without the UI. However, nothing documents running the product itself headlessly or in CI, and the Beta API is slated for discontinuation on September 1, 2026 in favour of a successor portal. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runtime, CI/pipeline guidance or examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.
